source_summary: Wide horizontal Chinese landscape with pale ink-and-color washes: wooded hills and village structures at left-center, small figures and rocky foreground shore, a gnarled riverbank tree with a small boat, and broad misty water with distant layered mountains and bird flocks to the right. Calligraphy and seals are excluded.

motifs.name: left_crag_bare_tree_cluster
motifs.description: Steep left hillside with pale layered rock washes and a cluster of tall leafless trees rising from the slope and lower bank; isolate the crag, trunks, branches, exposed roots, and sparse reddish-brown foliage near the base, excluding the adjacent inscription at the far left edge.
motifs.role: left foreground hillside and tree mass
must_preserve: pale gray-brown contour washes on the crag
dark dry-brush texture along the sloping rock face
exposed root strokes at the tree bases

motifs.name: rear_hamlet_hillside_field
motifs.description: Soft mid-left hillside with a tiny distant roof, terraced field patch, low embankments, and muted brushy vegetation behind the main grove; isolate the rolling hill forms and cultivated textures only.
motifs.role: midground hillside and distant hamlet detail
must_preserve: small dark roof silhouette on the hill
parallel hatch marks of the field plot

motifs.name: central_thatched_pavilions_grove
motifs.description: Central village cluster of low thatched pavilions tucked among tall bare trees, with dark roof beams, pale walls, surrounding trunks, and a dense dark grove behind.
motifs.role: central pavilion group and wooded village
must_preserve: dark stippled grove texture behind the buildings
subtle warm brown roof and foliage accents

motifs.name: gnarled_bank_tree_with_mooring
motifs.description: Riverbank section with a large gnarled leaning tree, exposed roots gripping the bank, adjacent low landform, and a small narrow moored boat or plank-like craft along the water edge.
must_preserve: root claw shapes at the bank
small horizontal boat form with dark outline

motifs.name: tiny_scholars_on_path
motifs.description: Two tiny robed figures walking on the path near the center, one with a warm orange robe accent, placed beneath sparse branches and beside the pale riverbank path.
must_preserve: thin path line beneath the figures
nearby delicate twig strokes only where attached to the figure setting

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_shore_shrubs
motifs.description: Low foreground shore with flat rock shelves, dark clustered shrubs, tufts of grass, and a small leafless bush rising from the bank; isolate the bottom-center land strip and vegetation textures.

motifs.name: right_hillside_trees_mist_bank
motifs.description: Right midground sloping bank with several sparse leafless trees and shrubs descending toward the water, partly softened by mist at the lower edge.
motifs.role: right midground hillside and misty bank
must_preserve: thin tree trunks and branch tips
dark shrub patches on the slope

motifs.name: distant_lake_mountains_bird_flocks
motifs.description: Broad right-side expanse of water and sky with layered distant mountain ridges, horizontal shorelines, soft mist bands, and scattered flocks of small birds rendered as dark dash marks.
motifs.role: distant lake, mountains, and atmospheric background
must_preserve: faint horizontal water and shoreline lines
soft mist edges between ridges and water

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
